name: Football Field
summary: Valuation ranges by methodology as floating horizontal bars, with current / offer price reference lines.
summary_zh: 按估值方法展示估值区间的横向浮动条形图，叠加当前股价 / 报价参考线。
description_zh: 投行估值页的标志性图表。每一行是一种估值方法（DCF、可比公司、先例交易、52 周股价区间、分析师目标价等），横条两端为估值区间下限/上限，竖虚线（主题参考线颜色）标出当前股价或报价，阴影带可标出建议报价区间。可按 group 着色区分内在价值 / 市场法 / 交易法，并在左上角给出图例；52 周股价区间、分析师目标价等仅作参考的行（referenceGroups）按投行惯例以灰色显示。
best_for: Equity value per share by methodology
Offer price positioning vs. intrinsic value

group.desc: Method family for colouring (Intrinsic / Market / Transaction)

note.desc: Basis shown in the tooltip (e.g. '8.0x–10.0x EV/EBITDA 2026E')

order.desc: Sort order (uses an 'order' field automatically when present)

refLines.desc: [{value, label, color, type}] vertical reference lines (current / offer price) — dashed, in the theme's reference colour unless color is set; labels above the plot, spread apart when values are close

refBand.desc: {from, to, label} shaded band, e.g. proposed offer range; the label sits above the reference-line labels

referenceGroups.desc: Groups drawn greyed with muted labels — market reference points rather than valuation methods (52-week range, analyst targets)

format.desc: Value format (defaults to the low field's format); axis ticks drop decimals when the step is whole

showValues.desc: Low / high labels at the bar ends

groupColors.desc: Colour bars by group (colours kept clear of the band and the reference-line colour)

legend.desc: Group key, top-left (when bars are coloured by group)

crossFilter.desc: Click a methodology to cross-filter other blocks

crossFilterScope.desc: dataset: the selection only filters blocks bound to the same dataset | global

interactions: Hover tooltip with low / high / midpoint and basis
Click a methodology to cross-filter (others dim)
Re-lays out on resize (tick density, reference-label spacing)
